name: PCT Fast Test Kit
shortDescription: Quantitative determination of PCT using the DX 101 Immunofluorescence Quantitative Analyzer.
intendedUse: quantitative determination of Procalcitonin (PCT) in human serum, plasma or whole blood samples. The test is used as an aid in the assessment and evaluation of patients suspected of bacterial infection, trauma or shock.
